name: refusals
about: What sova refuses, with the exit class and the sentence a person or a script gets: mistakes in the command line, answers the routes refuse, and a session a terminal holds, which nothing may write to while a title (Sova's own) still changes.

steps.name: a session to refuse things on

$some.text: The package name is in package.json.

steps.name: an unknown param
steps.stderr: sova: session.title.set has no param --colour (sova describe session.title.set)

steps.name: a change with no session named
a value off its list
steps.stderr: sova: --thinking must be one of: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max

steps.name: a host that isn't this machine
steps.stderr: sova: refused: 192.0.2.1 is not this machine (only 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1)

json.error: Unauthorized - reload the page to unlock

steps.name: an unknown session
steps.stderr: sova: session no-such-id: 404 No session with that id

steps.name: a title with a control character

json.error: title must be 1–80 characters, and no control characters
Tag "not a tag" is not valid: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 32.

steps.name: no message while a terminal has it

error.$match: ^It is open in a terminal \(pid \d+\), so this server must not write to it\.$

steps.name: no settings change while a terminal has it

error.$match: ^It is open in a terminal \(pid \d+\), so this server must not write to it\.$

steps.name: no archive while a terminal has it

json.error: This session is open in a TUI, so it stays on top while live. Nothing was archived.

steps.name: its transcript has only the first message
a title is Sova's own, so it still changes
